title: Android’s Ultra flagship era may be coming to an end
summary: Rising RAM prices are reportedly forcing major OEMs to cancel or scale back global releases for their top-tier Ultra phones.
body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority TL;DR Rising RAM prices are reportedly forcing Android OEMs to reconsider their lineups, with several reportedly scrapping or limiting global releases of their next-generation “Ultra” flagships. Leaks indicate Xiaomi has cancelled the Xiaomi 18 Ultra, while OPPO and vivo may withhold their next Ultra devices from global markets. Samsung may be left as the only manufacturer selling an “Ultra” flagship globally, while other Android brands shift to “Pro Max” branding for their top-tier phones. High RAM prices have pushed many phone makers to cut corners , and the resulting rise in component costs is also forcing brands to reconsider their lineups. The latest victims of the RAM crisis could be “Ultra” flagships, with leaks now suggesting that multiple Android OEMs are preparing to scrap their Ultra flagships, or at least severely scale back their global plans for them. About a month ago, leaker Yogesh Brar mentioned on X that Xiaomi has cancelled the Xiaomi 18 Ultra. It’s not clear whether the Ultra lineup has been entirely killed off or if this is merely a decision to skip a generation in light of the RAM crisis.

The four-part project, with each film focusing on a particular member, is slated to release in April 2028. title: This new Xbox 360 emulator for Android runs much better than I expected
summary: Not bad at all for a project that's been out for less than a month.
body: Credit: Hadlee Simons / Android Authority TL;DR A new emulator called XenDroid delivers surprisingly solid Xbox 360 emulation on Android. We were able to play games like Call of Duty 2, Forza Motorsport 2, and Project Gotham Racing 3. You’ll need a device running Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 silicon or higher for best results. We’ve already seen the first Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 emulators running on Android, but we’ve seen a couple of huge developments in the last few months. However, a new Xbox 360 emulator is making waves in recent weeks. XenDroid was first released on GitHub a few weeks ago (h/t: EmulationOnAndroid and Modern Vintage Gamer ), and it looks like a major step forward for Xbox 360 emulation on Android. According to the XenDroid GitHub page , it was initially conceived as a fork of the pioneering aX360e emulator. The developer later decided to rebase the app on the Xenia Edge PC emulator project.

title: PSA: Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 may mess up your home screen
summary: Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 can break common home screen features, including widgets, while also jumbling your app drawer.
body: TL;DR The recently released Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 update contains a couple of irritating bugs, including one that wreaks havoc on the Pixel Launcher and the home screen. Meanwhile, the update is also breaking the ability to add new widgets to the home screen, with some users also experiencing touchscreen issues after the update. Some have managed to remedy some of the issues by conducting a factory reset, while others have had luck by simply enabling and disabling Android’s private space. Google recently rolled out Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 , introducing the Quick Settings layout editor while adding new protections against call-forwarding scams. While these are decent additions to Android 17, Google’s latest beta update may also carry a couple of serious bugs that could render your phone unusable. According to a Pixel 9 Pro user replying to the Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 thread on Reddit , their home screen “blinks” while leaving an app after the update was installed. Moreover, doing so repeatedly sometimes causes the wallpaper to disappear, the user adds.

title: The Galaxy S22 just got a new shot at Android 17, thanks to LineageOS
summary: LineageOS 23 arrives on Galaxy S22, opening doors to an unofficial Android 17 update.
body: TL;DR LineageOS 23 has just added nightly builds for the Galaxy S22, S22+, and S22 Ultra. The new builds bring Android 16 to all three S22 models outside Samsung’s official software channel. LineageOS could give the S22 series an unofficial path to Android 17 in the coming months. Samsung officially closed the door on major OS upgrades for the Galaxy S22 series after omitting the flagship lineup from its One UI 8.5 roadmap . However, a massive third-party development has just flipped the script: official LineageOS support has finally landed on the S22, opening a clear, exciting path toward running Android 17 unofficially. This is particularly interesting because the Galaxy S22 isn’t exactly ancient hardware. Samsung launched the series in 2022, and these phones remain perfectly capable of handling everyday tasks. Yet Samsung’s One UI 9 update excludes the entire S22 lineup, effectively confirming that One UI 8 was the family’s final major OS upgrade.

title: Survey shows a slim minority would consider renting their next Android phone
summary: Not everyone is against a version of Apple Upgrade for Android makers.
body: Consumers face a world in which very little is actually “owned.” Many of us still rent homes and subscribe to streaming services for media, leasing cars is now a common practice, and there’s a good chance future gaming consoles may not support physical media. However, one of the few items we can still lay claim to is our smartphones — though that may soon change. Last month, Apple rolled out its Apple Upgrade program , a hardware-as-a-service model that allows users to rent their devices with a predictable monthly payment over a period of their choice. After that lease period ends, users can upgrade their device and continue the cycle. This essentially turns device ownership into a monthly utility payment, like gas or electricity, while making it far easier to keep up with annual device upgrades.

summary: توصل ناديا النصر والرياض إلى اتفاق يقضي بنقل مباراتهما المرتقبة في دوري روشن السعودي من ملعب مدينة الأمير فيصل بن فهد الرياضية إلى ملعب "الأول بارك".
body: توصل ناديا النصر والرياض إلى اتفاق يقضي بنقل مباراتهما المرتقبة في دوري روشن السعودي من ملعب مدينة الأمير فيصل بن فهد الرياضية إلى ملعب "الأول بارك". وبحسب صحيفة الرياضية السعودية ، فإن المباراة المقررة يوم الجمعة المقبل، ضمن منافسات الجولة الثانية من دوري روشن، باتت في انتظار موافقة رابطة الدوري السعودي للمحترفين، بعدما تقدمت إدارة النصر بطلب رسمي لإقامة اللقاء على ملعبها، عقب الاتفاق مع نادي الرياض. وأضافت أن الموافقة على نقل المباراة لن تؤثر على صفة الاستضافة، إذ سيظل نادي الرياض هو صاحب الأرض، وسيحصل على إيرادات المباراة، بعد خصم تكاليف التشغيل والصيانة. ويتصدر النصر جدول ترتيب دوري روشن السعودي برصيد 3 نقاط عقب الجولة الأولى، متفوقًا بفارق الأهداف على الهلال والاتفاق والقادسية ونيوم والحزم والأهلي. وقبل مواجهة الرياض، يستعد النصر لخوض اختبار جديد، عندما يلتقي الدرعية مساء الثلاثاء ضمن منافسات دور الـ32 من بطولة كأس خادم الحرمين الشريفين. اقرأ أيضا: ما موقف الزمالك من رحيل فتوح إلى الدوري السعودي؟   تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشترِ تذكرتك الآنَ!

title: Glastonbury 2027 Potential Headliners Ranked: Who Could Lead Next Year’s Festival?

title: نجم المغرب يعلق على إصابته الخطيرة

body: علق المغربي يوسف بلعمري، نجم الأهلي المصري، على إصابته الخطيرة التي تعرض لها مع المارد الأحمر. وسيغيب الظهير الأيسر عن الملاعب لفترة طويلة، بعد إصابته بقطع في الرباط الصليبي للركبة. وتحرك الأهلي سريعًا لتعويض غياب بلعمري، بالتعاقد مع توفيق محمد، ظهير أيسر بتروجت. وكتب بلعمري، عبر حسابه على إنستجرام "الحمد لله على كل حال، وقدر الله وما شاء فعل". وتابع "أمر اليوم بواحدة من أصعب اللحظات في مسيرتي، لكنني مؤمن بقضاء الله وقدره، ومؤمن أيضًا أن كل محنة تحمل في داخلها، درسًا وبداية جديدة". وأضاف "الإصابة جزء من كرة القدم، وقد تكون هذه الفترة صعبة وطويلة، لكنني سأتعامل معها بكل صبر وإصرار، وسأبذل كل ما أستطيع من أجل العودة في أفضل حالة ممكنة". ونوه بلعمري "أشكر من القلب، كل من سأل عني، وكل من تواصل معي وساندني بكلمة أو دعوة. دعمكم يعني لي الكثير، ولن أنساه أبدًا". وشدد "أعدكم أنني سأقاتل كل يوم، وسأعمل بكل قوة خلال فترة التأهيل لأعود إلى الملعب أقوى، وأكثر إصرارًا، بإذن الله.. شكرًا للجماهير المغربية وجماهير الأهلي على حبكم ودعمكم الدائم.. دعواتكم لي، والقادم بإذن الله أجمل". وكان يوسف بلعمري قد انضم لصفوف الأهلي، في الميركاتو الشتوي الماضي، قادمًا من الرجاء البيضاوي.

title: The hidden chip compromise lurking in today’s $1,000 smartphones
summary: Cut-down flagship chips could save you money. But are you getting a bargain or less than you paid for?
body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority Buying a flagship phone used to mean grabbing the fastest (or second fastest) processor on the market. That’s increasingly not always the case, and I’m not talking about Google’s new Tensor G6 in the Pixel 11 series . As flagship silicon gets more expensive, manufacturers are starting to put cut-down versions of familiar high-end chips into phones that still carry a premium price tag. At first glance, that sounds like a terrible deal. Why would you pay hundreds — or even thousands — for a phone that doesn’t have the full-fat version of its processor? But there’s a good reason this could actually be a positive development for consumers, particularly as the cost of flagship silicon continues to spiral.

title: How Sam Fender & Olivia Dean’s ‘Rein Me In’ Became the U.K.’s Longest-Running No. 1 Single Ever
summary: The song now holds the all-time record for the longest-running U.K. No. 1 single.
body: Sam Fender ’s show at the London Stadium in June 2025 remains momentous for many reasons. It was the midway point of the rollout of his Mercury Prize-winning LP People Watching , and also his largest ever headline show. But perhaps the most consequential moment from it came midway through the set, album deep cut “Rein Me In” got an airing, with the show’s support act Olivia Dean , then a rising star, joining on vocals for a new verse. Now their careers — and that song — appear unstoppable. “Rein Me In” is in record-breaking territory on the U.K.’s Official Singles Chart. The track has earned 21 weeks at No. 1, and became the longest-running No. 1 single of the 21st century after 16, surpassing Drake’s “Hotline Bling.” It has now pulled clear of Frankie Laine’s “I Believe” in the all time rankings, which notched 18 weeks at the summit back in 1953, to become the longest-running U.K. No. 1 single ever. title: هل يضم يوفنتوس مصطفى شوبير؟.. النادي الإيطالي يرد
summary: حسم نادي يوفنتوس الإيطالي موقفه من الأنباء التي ترددت خلال الساعات الماضية بشأن اهتمامه بالتعاقد مع مصطفى شوبير، حارس مرمى الأهلي، خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية الحالية.
body: حسم نادي يوفنتوس الإيطالي موقفه من الأنباء التي ترددت خلال الساعات الماضية بشأن اهتمامه بالتعاقد مع مصطفى شوبير، حارس مرمى الأهلي، خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية الحالية. وانتشرت تقارير إعلامية أشارت إلى أن الحارس المصري البالغ من العمر 25 عامًا دخل ضمن قائمة المرشحين لتدعيم مركز حراسة المرمى في صفوف "السيدة العجوز" قبل انطلاق الموسم الجديد. وفي المقابل، تواصل موقع Tribuna.com مع المكتب الإعلامي لنادي يوفنتوس للاستفسار عن صحة هذه الأنباء، والحصول على رد رسمي بشأن وجود مفاوضات مع حارس الأهلي. وجاء رد النادي الإيطالي قاطعًا، حيث نفى بشكل كامل وجود أي اهتمام بالتعاقد مع مصطفى شوبير. وقال ممثل يوفنتوس في تصريحات خاصة لـ Tribuna.com: "يوفنتوس لا يملك أي اهتمام على الإطلاق بالتعاقد مع مصطفى شوبير، واللاعب ليس ضمن خططنا". ولعب حارس الأهلي دورا بارزا في وصول منتخب مصر إلى دور الـ16 لكأس العالم للمرة الأولى في تاريخه، بعدما قدم سلسلة من العروض القوية التي لفتت أنظار متابعين وكشافين من عدة أندية خارج مصر. وبذلك، أغلق يوفنتوس الباب أمام الشائعات التي ربطت الحارس المصري بالانتقال إلى الدوري الإيطالي، مؤكدًا عدم وجود أي مفاوضات أو اهتمام بضمه خلال سوق الانتقالات الحالية. اقرأ أيضا: قبل مواجهة الأهلي.. رسالة من برشلونة بشأن حمزة عبد الكريم

title: The Pixel 11 Pro fixes my biggest complaint about older Pixel flagships
summary: Those Canyon and Olive colorways look fantastic.
body: The new Pixels are finally here: Google took the wraps off the Pixel 11 , 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, and 11 Pro Fold last week. Highlights of the series include a new sort of notification indicator called HiLight , iterative improvements to imaging and charging, and higher base storage across the board. Of course, the series also introduces some new colorways — and this year, Google’s Pro phones are unusually vibrant. It’s typically been the case that higher-end phones like Apple and Google’s Pro models and Samsung’s Ultra flagships tend to come in more subdued colors than their more affordable counterparts. You can get last year’s vanilla Pixel 10 in deep blue or sharp yellow-green finishes, for example, while the Pixel 10 Pro is available in white, gray, black, or a pastel green.

title: I replaced Duolingo with Gemini, and it’s (almost) the perfect alternative
summary: Gemini might quietly be the Duolingo replacement you've been looking for.
body: I’ve seen a few of my colleagues ditch Duolingo over recent years, and I can’t blame them. Over the past year alone, Duolingo has changed the goalposts for free users by introducing the energy system , then reshuffling the courses in a way that irked many people. Even before those changes, many users found the UI to be annoying and over-gamified. I’m much more forgiving, but I was curious to find out if Gemini could finally wrestle me free of my extensive Duolingo streak, which is now somewhere between an achievement and a hostage situation. I’m not setting out to trash the infamous green owl — it gets angry enough if you just miss a lesson. As I explained last year , having used Duolingo daily for years and amassed a monster streak, I still find it a useful learning tool despite its many flaws. But I live in Mexico, and having reached an intermediate level in Spanish, I feel like Duolingo has taken me as far as it can. Handy as it can be as a refresher, it’s repetitive and not particularly well-suited to real-life scenarios. Worst of all, it can’t adapt to my own personal circumstances, such as my particular weaknesses and the type of Spanish I want to learn.

title: Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 takes cell network security to the next level

body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority TL;DR Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 introduces a SIM security timeline to track and store records of modem-detected threats, such as IMEI/IMSI access by the cell network. A new SIM security info screen outlines active encryption ciphers across calls, SMS, emergency alerts, and data streams. We’ve also spotted new notifications that would alert users to a wider variety of cellular attacks, such as DoS, jamming, imprisonment, downgrade, and location tracking attacks. Google released Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 over the weekend, and with it, the company is significantly beefing up defense mechanisms for cell networks. Google first introduced the “ Mobile Network Security ” feature in Android 16, and the latest Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 release upgrades it to include a tracking timeline, cipher encryption details, and a broader array of cellular attack warnings. title: Anthropic reveals how Claude secretly watermarks AI-written text
summary: There are situations where Claude's watermarking solution might not be effective.
body: Credit: Mitja Rutnik / Android Authority TL;DR Anthropic has revealed how Claude’s text watermark system will work. Watermarks are used as Claude makes “low-stakes” choices between the words it will generate. Anthropic claims that the system doesn’t affect the content or quality of generated text, doesn’t leave hidden characters, and doesn’t need extra tokens. Google and OpenAI have adopted SynthID watermarks for images generated by their AI models. This allows people to find out whether that shared image is the real deal. Generated text is a different story, though. However, Anthropic announced last week that Claude can add watermarks to generated text , and it’s now revealed more details about the system. Anthropic explained in a blog post that Claude’s text watermark system is based on the SynthID-Text solution published by Google DeepMind. It adds that the watermark system isn’t visible to readers, doesn’t have a “practical” impact on content or quality of generated text, doesn’t have hidden characters, doesn’t require extra tokens, and can’t be traced to a specific person/organization/chat.

body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 has been released with the new Quick Settings layout editor, more granular theming controls, expanded blur effects, and improved multitasking controls for foldables. Google is also adding new protections against call-forwarding scams by restricting apps from triggering call-forwarding USSD codes and requiring confirmation when users dial them manually. The update also fixes crashes in Quick Settings and incorrect battery health warnings. Google has released Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 over the weekend, giving Pixel owners another preview of the next major quarterly Android update .
